facts.fact: The ministry's PAG 2016-2021 scorecard lists the Plateforme Nationale d'Interopérabilité (XROAD BJ) as put in place, among its smart government achievements.
The ministry's scorecard reports more than 42,000 data exchanges through XROAD BJ.
